Package index

Package overview

pmotoolsr pmotoolsr-package
pmotoolsr: Toolkit for working with Portable Microhaplotype Objects (PMOs)

Reading & writing PMOs

Read and write Portable Microhaplotype Object files (plain or gzip / bzip2 / xz compressed), as R6 objects or as raw nested lists.

read_pmo()
Read a PMO object from a file
write_pmo()
Write a PMO object to a file
read_pmo_raw()
Read a PMO file as a raw nested list
write_pmo_raw()
Write a raw PMO nested list to a file
pmo_list_to_r6()
Convert a raw PMO list into a PortableMicrohaplotypeObject

Validation & schema

Validate a PMO against the JSON Schema and inspect schema versions and field requirements.

pmo_validate()
Validate a PMO (structural and, by default, schema)
pmo_validate_jsonschema()
Validate a PMO against the JSON Schema
pmo_check_required_base_fields()
Check that a PMO has all required top-level fields
pmo_required_fields_for_class()
Get the required fields for a PMO schema class
pmo_load_schema()
Load a bundled PMO JSON schema
pmo_load_schema_by_version()
Load a bundled PMO JSON schema by version
pmo_schema_version()
Default PMO schema version targeted by this package
pmo_has_section()
Test whether an optional PMO section is present and non-empty

Processing & querying

Look up names and indices, count entities, and subset / filter a PMO down to selected specimens, library samples, targets, metadata groups, or read depth.

pmo_get_specimen_names() pmo_get_sorted_specimen_names() pmo_get_library_sample_names() pmo_get_sorted_library_sample_names() pmo_get_target_names() pmo_get_sorted_target_names() pmo_get_panel_names() pmo_get_sorted_panel_names() pmo_get_bioinformatics_run_names() pmo_get_sorted_bioinformatics_run_names()
Get entity names from a PMO
pmo_index_key_specimen_names() pmo_index_key_library_sample_names() pmo_index_key_target_names() pmo_index_key_panel_names() pmo_index_key_bioinformatics_run_names()
Build a name-to-index lookup for PMO entities
pmo_index_key_target_in_representative_microhaplotypes()
Build a target-name to representative-microhaplotype-index lookup
pmo_index_of_specimen_names() pmo_index_of_library_sample_names() pmo_index_of_target_names() pmo_index_of_panel_names() pmo_index_of_bioinformatics_run_names() pmo_index_of_target_in_representative_microhaplotypes()
Resolve entity names to their 1-based PMO indices
pmo_library_ids_for_specimen_ids()
Get library sample ids for a set of specimen ids
pmo_count_library_samples_per_target()
Count the number of library samples a target is detected in
pmo_count_specimen_by_field_value()
Count specimens grouped by combinations of metadata field values
pmo_count_specimen_per_meta_fields()
Count how many specimens carry each metadata field
pmo_count_targets_per_library_sample()
Count the number of targets detected per library sample
pmo_count_targets_per_panel()
Count the number of unique targets in each panel
pmo_filter_by_library_sample_ids()
Filter a PMO down to selected library samples
pmo_filter_by_library_sample_names()
Filter a PMO down to selected library samples by name
pmo_filter_by_specimen_ids()
Filter a PMO down to selected specimens
pmo_filter_by_specimen_names()
Filter a PMO down to selected specimens by name
pmo_filter_by_target_ids()
Filter a PMO down to selected targets
pmo_filter_by_target_names()
Filter a PMO down to selected targets by name
pmo_extract_by_read_filter()
Filter detected microhaplotypes by a minimum read count
pmo_extract_samples_by_meta_groupings()
Extract specimens matching metadata groupings
pmo_extract_allele_counts_freq()
Extract allele (microhaplotype) counts and frequencies

Exporting tables

Flatten PMO sections into tibbles and export allele tables, BED files, and Excel workbooks.

pmo_export_bioinformatics_methods_info_meta_table()
Export bioinformatics methods info metadata
pmo_export_bioinformatics_run_info_meta_table()
Export bioinformatics run info metadata
pmo_export_library_sample_meta_table()
Export library sample metadata
pmo_export_panel_info_meta_table()
Export panel info metadata
pmo_export_pmo_header_table()
Export PMO header metadata
pmo_export_project_info_meta_table()
Export project info metadata
pmo_export_sequencing_info_meta_table()
Export sequencing info metadata
pmo_export_specimen_meta_table()
Export specimen metadata
pmo_export_specimen_travel_meta_table()
Export specimen travel metadata
pmo_export_target_info_meta_table()
Export target info metadata
pmo_export_targeted_genomes_meta_table()
Export targeted genomes metadata
pmo_export_to_excel()
Export a PMO to a multi-sheet Excel workbook
pmo_extract_alleles_per_sample_table()
Extract a per-sample allele table
pmo_list_library_samples_per_specimen()
List library sample names per specimen
pmo_extract_targets_insert_bed()
Extract target insert locations as BED rows
pmo_extract_panels_insert_bed()
Extract panel insert locations as BED rows
pmo_write_bed()

Building & combining PMOs

Assemble PMOs from tabular inputs, merge components into a single object, update metadata, and combine multiple PMOs.

pmo_library_sample_info_table_to_pmo()
Convert a library-sample metadata table into PMO library_sample_info
pmo_mhap_table_to_pmo()
Convert a microhaplotype calls table into PMO microhaplotype structures
pmo_panel_info_table_to_pmo()
Convert a panel/target table into PMO target_info + panel_info
pmo_read_count_by_stage_table_to_pmo()
Convert read-count tables into the PMO read_counts_by_stage structure
pmo_specimen_info_table_to_pmo()
Convert a specimen metadata table into PMO specimen_info
pmo_minimum_library_specimen_from_mhap_table()
Build minimal library/specimen info from a detected-microhaplotypes structure
pmo_merge_panel_info_dicts()
Merge multiple panel_info dictionaries
pmo_merge_to_pmo()
Merge name-based PMO components into a complete PMO
pmo_combine_pmos()
Combine multiple PMOs into a single PMO
pmo_update_specimen_with_traveler_info()
Add travel history to a PMO's specimens
pmo_merge_dicts_by_key()
Merge two lists of dicts by a shared key field
